title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 22 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 22)

content.overview: The parties may agree on the language or languages to be used in the arbitral proceedings. Failing agreement, the arbitral tribunal determines the language or languages to be used.

content.study:
Section 22 — Language

The parties may agree on the language or languages to be used in the arbitral proceedings. Failing agreement, the arbitral tribunal determines the language or languages to be used.
